1.1.7
- Updated for the 2 November 2026 game patch (game build 1283531). After the patch 1.1.6 switched itself off ("host bindings unavailable; disabled" in greeneye\loader.log), so map teleport did nothing. On a dedicated server, update the server's copy too.
- Fixed: with the game in Russian, notices could come out in Ukrainian, depending on the form of the game's word for "Legendary". Russian and Ukrainian are now told apart reliably.
